messages:
maria: Quick thread — finalizing the autofallback rule editor UX. Need a short checklist before design handoff.
ajay: thanks — can we confirm the two main flows: route-scoped rules and org/global fallbacks?
devon: yes. frontend will expose both but prefer defaults from global. route-scoped rules should override and show diff in UI.
sarah: idea: show a small 'why this fired' pill in the preview that maps to error triggers (network, 5xx, timeout, model-error). keeps the canvas clean.
linus: also want to surface sampling rate and last-fired timestamp. SRE needs quick triage info.
maria: agreed. also need a compact audit row per decision with these fields: who triggered (auto/manual), policy-id, trigger-reason, runtime-weights, replaced-model.
ajay: on API shape: do we store decisions as a separate object so audit rows can reference them by id? devon: that'd be easier for the console to fetch, avoids duplicating heavy rule blobs per request.
sarah: design note — in the rule editor preview, include a simulated request input and a small timeline showing policy evaluation steps. e.g.,
```
input: { prompt_len: 120, model: "gptx-7b", latency_ms: 820 }
eval steps:
  - match route rule: false
  - match global degrade: true (timeout_rate>10%)
  - choose fallback: model-quantized-3B
```
maria: nice. what about operator overrides? we need a one-click 'takeover' that records operator id and reason. must be auditable.
linus: add a cooldown on overrides per operator (rate limit) to avoid noisy flip-flops. record TTL and auto-release.
ajay: telemetry events we need: policy_evaluated, policy_fired, operator_override, policy_rollback, audit_viewed. include small payload examples in the docs.
devon: payload sketch for policy_fired: `{"event":"policy_fired","policy_id":"p_123","route":"/v1/generate","reason":"model-runtime>1200ms","chosen_variant":"fallback-4b-quant","timestamp":1711117778}` — console can render that.
sarah: UX question — do we show historic false-positives? e.g., policy fired but response was OK. might help tuning.
maria: yes, add 'reconciliation' flag. backend should run a post-facto check and emit policy_reconciled event (ok/failed).
ops-bot: deployed branch `autofallback/editor-preview` to staging — endpoint `/staging/autofallback/preview`. Use header `X-Test-Policy: p_123` to simulate.
ajay: follow-ups: 1) API contract doc for audit rows 2) mock data for design 3) small acceptance criteria for SRE (latency, storage retention for audit logs). I'll make a ticket.
maria: perfect. tagging @sarah and @devon for handoff — if nothing else, I'll merge the spec tomorrow. :thumbsup:
